messages:
Alice M: @channel we're seeing a sudden spike of 5xx/504s for tenant=brightdata-prod on hosted API — started ~10m ago. CS pinged with multiple customer timeouts. Anyone oncall? :eyes:
Ben (oncall): I'm on it. Which request IDs and model? Any recent deploys?
Alice M: sample request_ids: abc123, def456. Logs show enqueue delays and queue_depth growth. Snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:34Z INFO enqueue_time=2120ms queue_depth=1024 req_id=abc123 model=redwood-v2.3.4
2026-03-17T10:12:35Z WARN continuous_batcher_backlog=230 host=hosted-eu-prod
2026-03-17T10:12:36Z ERROR downstream=503 req_id=def456
```
SRE-Bot: automated alert: hosted-eu-prod queue_depth > 900 for 12m, tail_timeout_rate=12%. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/queue-metrics?orgId=1&panelId=7
Carla (runtime): that looks like KV-cache cold starts combined with continuous-batcher backlog. Brightdata-prod traffic is many short requests which keeps batcher from forming good batches, causing long enqueue and tail timeouts.
Dan (support-eng): CS noted the first reports at 10:05 UTC which matches a small rollout. Alice, was there a kernel/cuda/runtime change in v2.3.4?
Alice M: there was a micro-deploy at 10:00 updating the attention kernel. Only rolled to ~20% of nodes.
Ben (oncall): immediate mitigations to try: 1) route tenant to fallback smaller quantized model, 2) reduce continuous_batcher.max_window_ms, 3) temporarily raise priority for prefetched KV warmers. I'll apply 1 & 2 now.
Ben (oncall): running API patch to route tenant: 
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"brightdata-prod","override_model":"redwood-small-q4","ttl_seconds":600}'
```
Ben (oncall): patch batcher config via k8s: 
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap batcher-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_window_ms":"10"}}'
```
SupportBot: Created escalation INC-2026-458 and notified Enterprise CS. Slack thread added to ticket.
SRE-Bot: action log: routing override applied for brightdata-prod -> redwood-small-q4 (ttl=600s). Batcher max_window_ms set to 10.
Alice M: after the overrides p95 dropped from ~3200ms to ~600ms within 2m. tail 504s decreased by ~55%. Still monitoring. :thumbsup:
Carla (runtime): Good. We should keep the tenant on fallback until we finish root-cause: investigate kernel perf change + batching behavior. Capture perf profile for the attention kernel and compare trace for heavy short-request traffic.
Dan (support-eng): I'll keep CS updated and ask customer to add slight client-side backoff/retry. Also scheduling postmortem with runtime team.
Ben (oncall): leaving open for 1h without regressions. Creating follow-up issue: INF-6842 investigate rollout sequencing + queue-depth safeguards. :eyes:
Alice M: adding logs and traces to ticket INC-2026-458. Thanks everyone.
